_comment: BattlerTagTypes deliberately NOT in CURATED_VOLATILE_TAGS (src/rl/spaces.ts). Three reason families: (transient) cleared before the next decision point so never observable in a decision-time snapshot; (covered) information already present via another encoded field; (BACKLOG:) persistent + decision-relevant -> encode-worthy, tracked in src/rl/docs/OBSERVATION_CHUNKS.md.

excluded.BANEFUL_BUNKER: transient: one-turn Protect variant, cleared before the next decision point
excluded.ENDURE_TOKEN: transient: consumed when it triggers, lapses at end of turn
excluded.BYPASS_SPEED: transient: within-turn priority bookkeeping (Quick Claw proc)
excluded.ELECTRIFIED: transient: one-turn move-type change, resolved within the turn
excluded.INTERRUPTED: transient: internal interruption marker during move resolution
excluded.PSYCHO_SHIFT: transient: status-transfer marker during move resolution
excluded.ROOSTED: transient: one-turn Flying-type suppression, restored before the next decision
excluded.STURDY: transient: per-hit endure marker applied during damage calculation
excluded.AUTOTOMIZED: covered: weight change is reflected in the encoded weight field (live pokemon.getWeight())
excluded.POWER_TRICK: covered: the Atk/Def swap is reflected in the encoded effective stats (live getStats)
excluded.GULP_MISSILE_ARROKUDA: covered: duplicates the visible Cramorant form change (form_index encoded)
excluded.GULP_MISSILE_PIKACHU: covered: duplicates the visible Cramorant form change (form_index encoded)
excluded.MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_POST_SUMMON: internal: mystery-encounter bookkeeping trigger, no battle semantics
excluded.ALWAYS_GET_HIT: BACKLOG: Glaive Rush vulnerability persists until the user's next turn — observable and targeting-relevant
excluded.BIND: BACKLOG: DamagingTrapTag family — encoded is_trapped covers the escape restriction, not the per-turn chip damage/duration
excluded.CHARGED: BACKLOG: persistent — next Electric move doubled (Charge)
excluded.FIRE_BOOST: BACKLOG: Flash Fire activated state (persistent 1.5x Fire boost)
excluded.HIDDEN: BACKLOG: semi-invulnerable charge state (Fly/Dig) persists across the inter-turn decision boundary — targeting-relevant
excluded.IGNORE_ACCURACY: BACKLOG: Lock-On sure-hit marker persisting to the next turn
excluded.IGNORE_DARK: BACKLOG: persistent type-immunity bypass (Miracle Eye family) — changes effectiveness
excluded.IGNORE_FLYING: BACKLOG: persistent grounding/immunity bypass (partially overlaps encoded is_grounded for Smack Down)
excluded.IGNORE_GHOST: BACKLOG: persistent type-immunity bypass (Foresight) — changes effectiveness
excluded.NIGHTMARE: BACKLOG: persistent sleep DoT (the move-level applies_continuous_damage flag covers the MOVE, not the active tag state)
excluded.PROTOSYNTHESIS: BACKLOG: paradox highest-stat boost state (verify whether encoded effective stats already reflect it)
excluded.QUARK_DRIVE: BACKLOG: paradox highest-stat boost state (see PROTOSYNTHESIS)
excluded.SUPREME_OVERLORD: BACKLOG: persistent Atk/SpAtk boost scaled by fallen allies (faint counts are encoded but the boost snapshots at entry)
excluded.TELEKINESIS: BACKLOG: persistent levitation + sure-hit state (3 turns)
excluded.TRUANT: BACKLOG: loaf-turn alternation — predicts whether the mon acts next turn
